subject: Request: trial extension + sandbox top-up due to CI blocker
messages:
From: Priyanka Singh <priyanka@apollotech.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Build pipeline blocked — asking for short extension/top-up

Hi Aisha —

Quick update from our side: our CI started failing yesterday during the adapter integration step (see attached ci-failure-log.txt). The engineering team traced it to a dependency mismatch introduced by the onboarding microservice; it's non-trivial and will take our devs roughly 10 business days to fully resolve because it requires a backport and a new QA pass.

We were counting on completing the last milestone (end-to-end demo) by Jun 26, but with this CI blocker we need more runway. Can Redwood provide a two-week trial extension and a small sandbox credit top-up so we can finish the adapter and re-run our evaluation? If possible, an incremental $1k sandbox credit would cover the additional token usage during our extended test runs.

We value the platform and want to keep the momentum — happy to jump on a quick call if you want more context.

Thanks,
Priyanka Singh
DevOps Lead, ApolloTech
Attachments: ci-failure-log.txt (text)
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Singh <priyanka@apollotech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 17:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Build pipeline blocked — asking for short extension/top-up

Hi Priyanka —

Thanks for the quick diagnostic and for attaching the log. Sorry to hear the backport is more invasive than expected. We definitely want to keep the pilot moving and avoid derailing the planned demo.

Proposed support from Redwood:
- Two-week trial extension (shift demo window from Jun 26 -> Jul 10)
- $1,000 sandbox credit top-up to cover additional evaluation runs
- A short mutual action plan so we have visibility on milestones and sign-offs (I attached a one-page proposed-mutual-action-plan.pdf).

Ben / Kim — can you confirm approvals on the credit and the extension? I'll prep an official confirmation email and a DocuSign/contract amendment if you approve.

Priyanka — if that works, I'll lock the dates and share the DocuSign link today.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0123
Attachments: proposed-mutual-action-plan.pdf (PDF)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 19:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Build pipeline blocked — asking for short extension/top-up

Aisha / Kim —

Approve $1,000 sandbox credit and a two-week extension for DL-4921-Apollo. Please note this is a one-time makegood due to engineering integration issues; escalate any further asks with clear technical justification. I've attached a quick CSV with approval metadata (credit-approval.csv).

Ben
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Priyanka Singh <priyanka@apollotech.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@apollotech.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Build pipeline blocked — asking for short extension/top-up

Aisha — this is great news, thank you. We accept the two-week extension and the credit top-up.

Two small asks from our side:
1) Can the extension be reflected in the HubSpot deal record (so procurement has a timeline)?
2) We'll need a simple amendment or confirmation email for procurement to approve the extra spend; a DocuSign link would be ideal.

Attaching a screenshot of the failing CI step (build-failure-screenshot.png) to help your engineering-facing folks triage once we hand off the ticket.

I'll aim to have the engineering milestone dates updated and shared with you by EOD. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Cheers,
Priyanka
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Singh <priyanka@apollotech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Build pipeline blocked — asking for short extension/top-up

Priyanka —

Confirmed: two-week extension and $1,000 sandbox credit have been approved for DL-4921-Apollo. I've updated the HubSpot deal and added the amendment to the activity feed (link below). DocuSign has been sent for signature — please sign the single-page amendment which just records the new demo date (Jul 10) and the credit top-up.

DocuSign (amendment): https://docusign.com/r/redwood/DL-4921-amendment
HubSpot deal: https://app.redwood.dev/deals/DL-4921-Apollo

Once signed, the credits will be visible in your sandbox account within 1 business hour. Reach out if your engineers want a short joint troubleshooting call — Ben / Kim, please coordinate with our solutions engineering team if they need to jump on a triage.

Thanks and talk soon,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: none
